reason: When I go out it's with family and we share, and at $38.95 for kalbi plus tax, and 20% added if we're five, that's way over what I spend when I've got other Korean places I already like. Nothing here tells me why this one instead.
objection: Korean food is everywhere in Honolulu and this is priced higher than the spots I already go to, with no reason given for why it's worth more.
would_change_my_mind: A family or group set that feeds four for around $80 to $90, or a friend or relative telling me the naengmyeon is really the best in town.
